purpose: Diagnostic regression experiment, not independent validation or SciClaimSeekers reproduction
candidate_recall_scope: Each arm's bounded pre-final pool; existing_rrf pool is unchanged existing implementation top-20, not its entire prefusion union
rescore_method: Same normalized dense cosine; NOT cross-encoder, NOT LLM reranking
expected_control: union_dense_rescore top-k equals exact_dense top-k for k <= candidate_depth with common deterministic tie rules
latency_scope: Cold and warm complete-four-arm candidate collection per query; cold means uncached query embedding with model already initialized during build, not cold process/model loading
promotion_requirements: Fresh independent human-reviewed relevance labels frozen before tuning
